body.query: Which year recorded the most consumption of gas paid in CZK?

raw_response.sql:
SELECT LEFT(date, 4)::INTEGER AS year,
       SUM(consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth
GROUP BY LEFT(date, 4)::INTEGER
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 1;
raw_response.query: Which year recorded the most consumption of gas paid in CZK?

reason.answer: The query returns one row containing the calendar year with the highest total gas consumption and the corresponding summed consumption value. The year is derived from the year-month label of each monthly consumption record, and the totals are aggregated across all customers so the leading year reflects the peak overall consumption paid in CZK.
reason.business:
- Derive the calendar year from each monthly consumption record's year-month label.
- Sum all consumption recorded within each year, across all customers.
- Rank the years by total consumption from highest to lowest.
- Return the single leading year so the answer directly identifies the period with the greatest consumption.
- Prices in this dataset are denominated in Czech koruna, so the aggregation reflects gas consumption paid in CZK.
reason.technical:
## Common Table Expressions
- (not used)

## Projected Columns
- The calendar year, derived from the leading four characters of the year-month label and cast to an integer.
- The summed consumption for that year, named total_consumption.

## Source
- The monthly consumption-per-customer dataset, which provides a year-month label and a consumption amount.

## Joins
- (not used) The consumption measures already carry all needed information for a year-level roll-up.

## Filters
- No additional filters; the entire consumption history is included so the year comparison covers all recorded activity (prices in this dataset are in CZK).

## Aggregation
- Group records by derived year.
- Aggregate using SUM of consumption to obtain total annual consumption.

## Sorting
- Order years by total_consumption descending so the largest total appears first.

## Result Limit
- LIMIT 1 to return only the single year with the highest total consumption, directly answering the question.

## Union
- (not used)
